evals.name: save-stream-test-procedure
evals.prompt: This is a Claude Code project. session-log.md records how we finally got the stream consumer tests running after several failed tries yesterday. Save the working procedure so future sessions in this workspace follow it instead of repeating those mistakes. You have my approval to write it; do not wait for confirmation. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines where workspace skills live (.claude/skills/ws-<name>/SKILL.md for Claude Code), the frontmatter (ws- prefix, origin: agent-created, version, last_used, related), and the four required parts: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls, verification. Without it, a model may write a README or CLAUDE.md note, omit provenance, or keep the narrative of failed attempts instead of distilling pitfalls.
expectations: A new ws- skill with matching name, origin agent-created, version 1
The existing user-authored skill is untouched

Skill anatomy: Has When to use (triggers), numbered steps with exact commands (LocalStack run, exports, create-table with streams, npm run test:stream), Pitfalls, Verification; frontmatter includes description, last_used and related

Pitfalls distilled from the failures: Names all three: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL unset hits real AWS, table not auto-created and needs streams enabled, AWS_REGION must be us-east-1 or ExpiredIteratorException; plus dummy credentials
Verification is checkable: 9/9 tests pass and dynamodbstreams list-streams --region us-east-1 shows one stream for orders-local
Respects existing content and scope: Does not touch ws-integration-tests (or relates to it only via related:), tells me where the skill was written
The new skill is written under .claude/skills/ws-<name>/SKILL.md (the Claude Code location), not under .kiro/skills/ or as a README or CLAUDE.md note.

scripted_checks.text: A new ws- skill with matching name, origin agent-created, version 1
scripted_checks.check:
python3 -c "import glob,re,sys;fs=[f for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/ws-*/SKILL.md') if 'ws-integration-tests' not in f];ok=False
for f in fs:
  t=open(f).read();d=f.split('/')[2]
  ok=ok or (re.search(r'^name:\s*'+re.escape(d)+r'\s*$',t,re.M) and re.search(r'^origin:\s*agent-created',t,re.M) and re.search(r'^version:\s*1\s*$',t,re.M))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

scripted_checks.text: The existing user-authored skill is untouched

evals.name: update-user-authored-itest-skill
evals.prompt: Update the integration-tests procedure for this workspace: before `make itest` you now also need `docker compose up -d mock-auth` and `export AUTH_URL=http://localhost:9000`. Go ahead and write it without asking me. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
evals.expected_output: The skill's provenance gate says user-authored skills are immutable to agents even when asked to update them: create a new agent-created skill with related: [ws-integration-tests] and say why. Without the skill, the natural move is to edit the existing file in place.
expectations: The user-authored ws-integration-tests skill is byte-identical
A new agent-created skill relates to the original and includes the mock-auth step
Provenance handling: Leaves the user-authored file untouched, creates a new ws- skill with origin: agent-created and related: [ws-integration-tests]
New procedure is complete: Full step order: postgres up, mock-auth up, AUTH_URL export, migrate, itest; carries over the ~5s Postgres pitfall and verification
Explains the choice: Tells me the original is user-authored so it was not edited, and suggests I merge or retire one of the two
No overreach: No other files changed
The new skill is written under .claude/skills/ws-<name>/SKILL.md (the Claude Code location), not under .kiro/skills/.

scripted_checks.text: The user-authored ws-integration-tests skill is byte-identical
A new agent-created skill relates to the original and includes the mock-auth step
scripted_checks.check: python3 -c "import glob,re,sys;fs=[f for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/ws-*/SKILL.md') if 'ws-integration-tests/' not in f];sys.exit(0 if any(re.search(r'^related:.*ws-integration-tests',open(f).read(),re.M|re.S) and re.search(r'^origin:\s*agent-created',open(f).read(),re.M) and 'mock-auth' in open(f).read() for f in fs) else 1)"
